test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 02 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following awards is not awarded on National sports Day?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Paramveer Chakra.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Paramveer Chakra is a military decoration awarded for acts of valor and bravery in the face of the enemy.**
 
• The Arjuna Award is given to recognize **outstanding achievement in sports at the national level.**
 
• The Dronacharya Award is given to** honor excellence in sports coaching.**
 
• The Dhyan Chand Award is given for lifetime achievement in sports and games.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Paramveer Chakra **is the highest m**ilitary decoration in India, followed by the Mahavir Chakra and the Vir Chakra.**
 
• **The Arjuna Award** was instituted in** 1961 and has been awarded to many notable athletes, including Sachin Tendulkar, Sania Mirza, and Saina Nehwal.**
 
• **The Dronacharya Award **was named after the legendary **coach Dronacharya from the epic Mahabharata.**
 
• The Dhyan Chand Award was named after the legendary hockey player Dhyan Chand, who won three Olympic gold medals for India.
